sents.d: Search traffic compounds over time in a way paid ads don't.

Search engine optimization is a longer-term investment than paid ads, but content that ranks well can keep bringing in traffic for years without ongoing spend, which makes it worth starting early even if results take time.

For most small businesses, the highest-leverage starting point is local SEO — claiming and fully completing a Google Business Profile, and ensuring your business name, address, and phone number are consistent everywhere they're listed online.

Beyond that, writing content that directly answers the specific questions your customers actually search for — rather than generic industry topics — tends to rank better and convert better than content written primarily to sound authoritative.

take: Claim your Google Business Profile and answer real questions.
